notes: EU measures restricted import, purchase, and transport of Iranian crude oil and petroleum products, with existing contracts phased out by July 2012.

event_name: Oil price slide begins amid supply growth and weaker demand
notes: Approximate start of the 2014-2016 oil price collapse period driven by weaker demand expectations and rising non-OPEC supply.

event_name: OPEC maintains 30 million bpd output ceiling
notes: OPEC kept its production level at 30 million barrels per day instead of cutting output during a falling price environment.
Agreement created expectations that Iranian barrels could return to the market after sanctions relief.
Implementation Day lifted nuclear-related sanctions and increased expectations of Iranian crude supply returning.
OPEC agreed to reduce production by about 1.2 million barrels per day, effective January 2017.

event_name: OPEC and non-OPEC producers extend cuts
notes: Participating producers extended production adjustments to support rebalancing after the 2016 agreement.

event_name: United States exits JCPOA and starts reimposing Iran sanctions
notes: U.S. withdrawal from the Iran nuclear deal began a sanctions reimposition process affecting energy and petrochemical sectors.
OPEC and non-OPEC producers agreed another output adjustment after late-2018 price weakness.

event_name: Saudi Aramco Abqaiq and Khurais attacks
notes: Attacks disrupted Saudi oil infrastructure and led to the largest one-day Brent move in the prior decade when trading reopened.

event_name: U.S. strike kills Iranian commander Qasem Soleimani
notes: Escalation raised perceived supply disruption risk even though no immediate oil production was lost.

event_name: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic
notes: The pandemic shock sharply reduced transport and industrial demand for oil.
OPEC+ agreed to cut production by 9.7 million barrels per day from May 2020 after the pandemic demand collapse.
OPEC+ agreed to raise production by 0.4 million barrels per day each month starting August 2021.

event_name: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
notes: The invasion intensified energy supply risks and triggered sanctions responses affecting Russian energy trade.

event_name: United States bans Russian oil and energy imports
notes: The U.S. announced a ban on imports of Russian oil, liquefied natural gas, and coal.

event_name: OPEC+ announces 2 million bpd production cut
notes: OPEC+ agreed to reduce overall production by 2 million barrels per day from August 2022 required levels starting November 2022.
